title: Girl with Yellow Barrette
content: Okay so I wanted to share my latest experience with Mall World last night. I have been having these dreams since I was a kid (i'm 47F) and recently found out other people have had the same dreams and places that we are now calling mall World. I also want to make note that on occasion I can lucid dream too. Last night I was dreaming and realized I was dreaming and became lucid. I even thought to myself 'Wow this is really detailed and not as gross or as frustrating as some of the other mallworld dreams. When I figure out I can lucid dream the first thing I do is fly. After flying around for a bit I ended up standing in a line for this weird antique store (that was outside) not even sure what they were selling that I was suppose to buy. I look at a girl in line near me and she caught my eye. I saw a bright yellow barrette in her hair and in the dream thought, didn't we say in a tik tok video if we wanted to try to recognize someone else to wear yellow? I was nervous to talk to her because i heard you are not suppose to admit you know you are dreaming or mention mallworld in the dream state. I took a chance and walked over to her and said "Have you ever heard of Mallworld?" She said yes and we began talking. She mentioned my Yellow shirt and i pointed to her yellow barrette. "Isn't this wild?" I asked her. Then I asked if she can also lucid dream and fly and she said oh yeah. We flew to the top of a short tree briefly. I said "okay so how do we try to find each other in the real world?" She told me that she uses the name Griffin Rider (could be spelled different as she told this to me and it wasn't written down). I told her I typically use RiverWitch as well as my actual name. Next we were on the ground near the large water fountain sculpture and there were a large group of girls suddenly around her and I was like oh these must be her friends and was about to leave. They are starting to walk down the path to lead her with them and she stops, grabs my arm and says "Don't leave me". I started to say I wouldn't but then i felt something on my back and told her "I'm so sorry but my dog is kicking my back and it's waking me up and I am starting to lose connection." Sure enough my dog who sleeps in our bed was having her own dream and kicking her paws into my back when I woke up. SO this is a long shot and super crazy but if anyone else had a similar experience let me know! It was surreal and I think I will literally freak out if I find this person I met in Mall world. Just had to share my spooky experience!
